About LB Books

A Publishing House Built for Readers Who Believe in Magic

LB Books was born from a simple and unshakeable conviction: that the right story, found at the right moment, changes everything. We are a Scottish independent publisher dedicated to stories that linger, characters that feel like old friends, and worlds that call you back long after the final page.

From enchanting adventures for the youngest readers to sweeping young adult fiction that does not flinch from the complexity of growing up, our titles are crafted with care, published with integrity, and sent into the world with genuine love for the readers who receive them.

We also champion independent authors. LB Books exists not just to publish our own stories, but to help brilliant voices find their audience, on their own terms.

✦

Authenticity. Every book we publish is one we genuinely believe in.

✦

Independence. No compromise on quality, story, or the author's vision.

✦

Community. Readers and writers belong together. We build that bridge.
